name: **Daedalus — Product Requirements Document (PRD)**
description: **Status:** Active / Source of Truth **Audience:** Engineers, Designers, Operators **Goal:** Enable continued feature shipping without naming churn, architectural confusion, or large refactors.

userStories.title: Enrich a CSV of leads
userStories.description: As a **RevOps leader**, I want to upload a CSV of leads and receive enriched records with company, role, firmographics, and tech stack so that my team can segment and prioritize outreach without manual research.

userStories.title: Enrich a single lead
userStories.description: As an **AE or SDR**, I want to enrich a single person or company from an email, name, or domain so that I can quickly personalize an email or call without leaving my workflow.

userStories.title: Extract brand identity from a URL
userStories.description: As a **marketer**, I want to input a brand’s website URL and receive a structured brand identity (logo, colors, fonts, voice, key messages) so that I can generate on-brand assets and compare against competitors.

userStories.title: Monitor critical pages for changes
userStories.description: As a **competitive intelligence owner**, I want to set up monitors on pricing, feature, or policy pages so that I am alerted when competitors ship meaningful changes and can respond quickly.

userStories.title: Run scouts to discover new signals
userStories.description: As a **growth or strategy lead**, I want to configure scouts that run recurring web searches and deduplicate results so that I only see new, relevant mentions (jobs, press, launches) instead of noisy, repeated alerts.

userStories.title: Run research sessions with agents
userStories.description: As a **strategist or researcher**, I want an agent-driven research view with streaming thinking, answers, and sources so that I can ask complex questions, see how conclusions were reached, and drill into the underlying evidence.

userStories.title: Manage plans, usage, and billing (GEO)
userStories.description: As a **workspace admin**, I want to manage plans, usage limits, and billing in one place so that I can control access to primitives (enrich, extract, observe, scout, agent) and stay within budget without unexpected overages.
